title: Gishora Tambourinaire victory in Gitega
description: The closing of the week dedicated to the emblematic dance of the drums of Burundi whose ceremonies which took place on November 25, in the pregnant of the National Museum of Gitega saw the competition of all the provincial troops from the whole country. The provincial troop of Gitega came out champion, with a note of 83%, followed by Bujumbura-Mairie with 80%. At the place of these two troops, Mr. Gaston Sindimwo gave an envelope of 1,000,000 FBU and 800,000 FBU respectively. Besides, he granted each troop, an envelope of 500,000 FBU.
